subject: Summit Analytics evaluation checklist and ops guardrails
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Hart <alex.hart@summitanalytics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-05-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Summit Analytics evaluation checklist and ops guardrails

Alex — thanks for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we’re aligned heading into the evaluation window: 

1) Success criteria (agreed during call)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 400ms for single-turn text gen across typical payloads (avg token length ~120)
- Cost: Target <= $0.004 / generated token (on our reserved plan baseline)
- Quality: prompting A/B test vs. your current endpoint shows >= 5% improvement on intent match for the 10 test prompts you shared
- Reliability: no more than 1% HTTP 5xx over 2-week run

2) Proposed evaluation plan (attached) — 3 weeks total- Week 0 (prep): data ingest, baseline test dataset (you to deliver sample by 5/18)- Week 1: dry-run + perf tuning (prefix caching + batching knobs)- Week 2: steady-state runs + cost/quality measurements

3) Capacity & guardrails (what we propose now)- Reserved baseline: 2x A10-equivalent instances (persistent for the 3-week window)- Autoscale policy: up to 6 instances for burst up to 30 minutes; scale down if 95th p90 token latency > 90% of SLO or if concurrency < thresholds- KV/prefix cache: enabled for your common prefixes (we’ll pre-warm on dry-run)

4) Operational ownership- AE: Stephanie Nguyen (you’ve been looped)- CS/Onboarding: Marissa Cole — runbook and daily checks- Infra/Capacity: Rishi Malhotra — reserve/monitor GPUs and handle burst policy

5) Security/compliance- You asked about evidence for data residency and audit logs — attaching our short TOE; we’ll need to confirm if anything else from your security team is required before 5/18.

Next steps for us: I’ll drop the evaluation spreadsheet (attached) into the Drive link and Rishi will confirm the reservation window by EOD tomorrow. For you: please share the 2–3 representative prompt sets + any throughput/concurrency expectations by 5/18.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with your team.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com

Attachment: Summit-eval-plan.xlsx
From: Alex Hart <alex.hart@summitanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procure@summitanalytics.com
Date: 2028-05-12T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit Analytics evaluation checklist and ops guardrails

Thanks, Stephanie — this looks good and matches our internal read. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Data residency: our initial PoC data is US-only, but we may want EU hosting later; can Redwood support a simple region swap mid-eval or would that require a new reservation?
- Concurrency: we plan to run up to 120 concurrent sessions during peak bench; is the autoscale policy you proposed sufficient? If not, give us expected latency vs concurrency numbers so we can set realistic load targets.

We’ll upload a small sample dataset (10k rows) and the 10 test prompts by 5/18. Procurement looped in for the evaluation order form — they may need the reserved-capacity pricing sheet. Let me know if you want us to schedule a quick 20-min call with our infra lead on Friday to align on test harness.

Alex
Alex Hart
Head of ML Ops, Summit Analytics
alex.hart@summitanalytics.com

Attachment: Summit-security-TOE.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2028-05-13T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Reserved capacity & autoscale plan for Summit (DEAL-8731)

Following Stephanie’s note — I’ve provisionally reserved the baseline capacity you asked for on our internal staging pool: 

- Baseline reservation: 2x A10-equivalent GPUs from 2028-05-19 00:00 UTC through 2028-06-09 23:59 UTC (3-week window + buffer)
- Autoscale: policy attached to the reservation allows scaling to 6 instances for 30-minute bursts. Burst policy triggers: sustained queue depth > 60 reqs for 5 minutes OR 95th percentile token latency > 80% of configured SLO.
- Pre-warm: I’ll kick off prefix cache pre-warm during the dry-run window and add sample keys once Summit uploads their prompts.

Operational notes / constraints:
- If Summit sustains > 6 instances for more than 2 hours in a day, we’ll need to move to a short-term dedicated burst uplift (manual approval) — call this out in the runbook for transparency.
- I’ve set up monitoring dashboards and an alert group: infra-rishi@redwood.example.com, cs-marissa@redwood.example.com.

Owners & immediate actions:
- Rishi: confirm GPU reservation with infra (in progress) — target: EOD 2028-05-13
- Marissa: prepare onboarding checklist and test harness instructions for Summit — target: 5/17
- Stephanie: get sample prompts + procurement contact for ordering reserved capacity (Alex said they looped procurement)

I’ll post the reservation ticket and runbook link here once everything’s live.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
